# ING Think

> > Economic research and analysis from ING, covering FX markets, currency strategy, and global economic trends.

ING Think is the research platform of ING Group, featuring insights from economists and strategists including Chris Turner, Francesco Pesole, Frantisek Taborsky, and Deepali Bhargava. The platform provides analysis on foreign exchange markets, G10 and emerging market currencies, and macroeconomic developments.

## Key Topics

- ING
- Chris Turner
- Francesco Pesole
- US dollar
- G10 currencies
- FX strategy
- Currency markets
- Dollar decline
- Emerging markets
- Frantisek Taborsky
- Deepali Bhargava
- FX Talking webinar series

- [FX Talking: How far can the dollar fall?](https://webinars.think.ing.com/fx-talking-how-far-can-the-dollar/join): Webinar on US dollar decline with ING FX strategists Turner & Pesole
